purpose: Prevent future external state-forecast performance claims from being conflated with the separate operational support/abstention diagnostic.

operational_support_gate.purpose: Decide whether autonomous action is permitted for a particular input history; abstention is not attack/OOD detection and is not a state-forecast accuracy metric.
operational_support_gate.fit_policy: center/scale on development train only; threshold on development validation only

claim_boundaries.forecast_pass: Only supports fresh external state-transition forecasting versus persistence for the exact registered holdout.
claim_boundaries.support_pass: Only supports operational runtime compatibility/eligibility; does not prove benignness, maliciousness, or forecasting accuracy.
